verdict.rationale: Deel's global payroll page says it runs compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries. This covers both the EOR route and the owned-entity payroll route. Its MCP tooling includes an EOR-versus-entity hiring cost comparison, and a community user reports having about 75 people hired through Deel. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the EOR hiring and onboarding flow and on owned-entity payroll setup (current evidence is mostly marketing copy), API-level EOR contract creation (only contractor contract creation is shown), and independent hands-on corroboration of the payroll quality itself.
